title: BlobUploadResponse sha256 is draft-only, not RFC 8620
description: RFC 8620 section 6.1 does not define a sha256 field in the blob upload response. The sha256 field in BlobUploadResponse comes from draft-atwood-jmap-cid. Callers may assume it is standard and rely on it being populated. If the draft changes the field name the struct shape changes as a breaking API change. The field should be documented as draft-extension-only or gated behind a cargo feature.
